text: I think you'll enjoy making Cheerios Nuggets, and they're quick to prepare within your 60-minute time frame. The recipe is vegan-friendly, which aligns with your dietary preferences. The combination of Cheerios, peanuts, and raisins provides a satisfying crunch, while the chocolate M&M's add a sweet touch. This snack is also relatively low in saturated fat and high in fibre, making it a relatively healthy option. The recipe's short preparation time and simple ingredients also make it a great choice for a fun baking project.
